card.name: Words just before FDA approval
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected FDA or approval term, such as 'by' after 'cleared' or 'approved', or 'was' before 'approved by the FDA'. Seen in drug-label text on regulatory status of tests, devices and drugs.

modes.label: By after cleared/approved
modes.description: The word 'by' after 'cleared' or 'approved', just before 'the FDA'.
modes.example: use a test approved or cleared<< by>> the FDA as an aid in the diagnosis

modes.label: Linking word before approved
modes.description: A small verb or negation that leads straight into 'approved' or 'approval'.
modes.example: manufactured by Elan under the brand name PRIALT®,<< was>> approved by the FDA in 20

modes.label: Support/supporting approval
modes.description: A verb about trials that supported approval of a drug.
modes.example: clinical trials<< supporting>> approval of Symbyax (fixed dose

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict 'approval' or 'approved' next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before the text says something was approved or cleared by the FDA.
